sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: MoneyPrinterTurbo makes short videos automatically from a topic or keyword. It writes the script with AI, finds stock or AI-generated footage, adds voiceover, subtitles and music, and renders the final video.
sixtySeconds.problem: Making a short video by hand means writing a script, finding clips, recording narration, timing subtitles and editing. MoneyPrinterTurbo automates those steps while letting you change each stage.
whoFor: Creators making short videos for TikTok, Instagram or YouTube Shorts
Developers automating video generation through an API or CLI
People who want to try AI video without editing skills
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want an all-in-one, self-hosted pipeline from topic to finished short video. Output quality depends on the models, voices and footage services you connect.
requirements: Windows 10+, macOS 11+ or a mainstream Linux
Python 3.11 or later (3.11 recommended) for local installs
4 GB RAM minimum, 8 GB recommended; a GPU is optional
API keys for the AI, footage and voice services you choose

overview: You give MoneyPrinterTurbo a topic and it goes from script to voiceover, footage, subtitles, music and editing, while letting you review or replace each stage. It runs as a WebUI, an API, a CLI, or through an AI agent that reads its skill file.

Scripts can come from many LLM providers or your own text. Footage can be your own files, free stock from Pexels and Pixabay, or AI-generated clips from several video model services. Voiceover options include free Edge TTS (no key needed) and many paid voices, and subtitles can be generated from TTS timings or local Whisper.

It exports 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1 videos and can publish directly to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. The official PyPI package is mpt; the README notes that the package named MoneyPrinterTurbo on PyPI is maintained by a third party.
